## Purpose

This document combines the filtered GenDiv populations from
`01_initial_filtering.qmd` with additional studies compiled externally
using the same criteria, and writes the merged table for downstream
Objective 1 analyses.


## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(ggplot2)

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
```

```{r}
#| label: paths

path_gendiv <- here("Data", "interim", "GenDiv_filtered.csv")
path_new    <- here("Data", "external", "new_studies_vYYYY-MM-DD.csv")
path_out    <- here("Data", "interim", "GenDiv_merged.csv")
```

## Read data

```{r}
#| label: read
gendiv <- read.csv(path_gendiv)

has_new <- file.exists(path_new)
new_dat <- if (has_new) read.csv(path_new) else gendiv[0, ]
```

GenDiv has **`r fmt(nrow(gendiv))`** populations from
**`r fmt(n_distinct(gendiv$Study_id))`** studies and
**`r fmt(n_distinct(gendiv$Spec_id))`** species.
`r if (has_new) paste0("The external dataset has **", fmt(nrow(new_dat)), "** populations from **", fmt(n_distinct(new_dat$Study_id)), "** studies and **", fmt(n_distinct(new_dat$Spec_id)), "** species.") else "**No external file found yet**, so the merge below contains GenDiv populations only."`

## Merge

```{r}
#| label: merge
merged <- rbind(gendiv, new_dat)
```

The merged dataset has **`r fmt(nrow(merged))`** populations from
**`r fmt(n_distinct(merged$Study_id))`** studies and
**`r fmt(n_distinct(merged$Spec_id))`** species.

## Map of all populations

```{r}
#| label: map
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5.5
states <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, year = 2023, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  filter(!STUSPS %in% c("HI", "PR", "AK", "MP", "GU", "AS", "VI")) |>
  st_transform(crs = 5070)

merged_sf <- st_as_sf(merged, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(crs = 5070)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = merged_sf, aes(color = He)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    limits = range(merged$He),
    breaks = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.2)
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Write output

```{r}
#| label: write-output
write.csv(merged, path_out, row.names = FALSE)
```

Wrote **`r fmt(nrow(merged))`** rows × `r ncol(merged)` columns to
`r basename(path_out)`.
